overview: Computer Science Engineering in Italy is a great option for Indian students who are looking to build a career in software development, artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and advanced computing technologies. Undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in Italian universities are designed to integrate the fundamentals of computer science with practical learning, research, and technical skills.

Students can pursue a Bachelor's in Computer Science Engineering in Italy after Class 12 or a Master's in Computer Science Engineering in Italy after a related undergraduate degree. Depending on the university the program titles could be Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology.

Italy provides to study in an international academic environment, search for scholarship opportunities, and develop skills relevant to the global technology industry. But course language, tuition fees, admission requirements and degree structures vary from institution to institution.

sections.title: Why Study Computer Science Engineering in Italy?

items: Indian students opt for Italy for computer science and computer engineering studies for a number of reasons.
International education: Study in Italian universities for recognized undergraduate and postgraduate degrees.
Technology specializations: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, cyber security, data science, computer networks.
English-taught programs Some universities offer English-taught Bachelor's and Master's programs, but choices depend on the degree and the university.
Hands-on learning: Selected courses include programming labs, group projects, research and industry related assignments.
Scholarships: Students who may be eligible can search for university scholarships and local financial aid programs.
International career paths: Graduates can pursue roles in software companies, technology consultancies, fintech, research, and other industries based on their skills and work authorization.

It is important to choose a program that suits your intended career. Computer Science is generally more about algorithms, software and computing theory. Computer Engineering may have more of a focus on computer hardware, embedded systems, electronics and integrated computing technologies.

sections.title: Who Can Study Computer Science Engineering in Italy?

items: Indian students generally must meet the following criteria:
12th Pass or equivalent recognized school leaving qualification.
An appropriate educational background, particularly in mathematics and other relevant scientific subjects.
Entrance exam or selection process organized by the university.
Knowledge of the Italian language for courses taught in Italian.
English language proficiency at the level required for an English taught program.
Some universities may require an entrance test like TOLC-I or a specific university test. The test and selection process varies from course to course.
A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering or related field.
Sufficient credits in relevant subjects such as programming, algorithms, mathematics, computer systems and engineering.
Academic performance satisfactory to the program.
Any other documents, assessments or requirements stated by the university.

Applicants with degrees in other engineering disciplines may be considered if their prior coursework meets the necessary prerequisites. Admission is not automatic and will be subject to an academic evaluation of the program.

sections.title: Computer Science Engineering Admission In Italy

items: Pick your degree level: You'll have to decide whether you want to pursue a Bachelor's post Class 12 or a Master's after an under-graduate degree.
University selection: Check the course content, language of instruction, course duration, tuition fees and specializations.
Check eligibility: School subject requirements for Bachelor's programs or subject credit requirements for Master's programs.
Gather Documents: Collect academic transcripts, identification, language test scores, and other necessary documents.
Entrance test / academic evaluation: Follow pattern given by university.
Apply: Complete your application on the university's official portal before the deadline.
Accept your offer and scholarships: Follow the instructions to accept your offer, enroll and apply for funding.
Visa requirements You need to follow the proper Italian student-visa procedure and check if you have to pre-enrol through Universitaly.

For the 2026-2027 intake, please contact the university directly for the most up-to-date application dates and procedures. If you're applying for a Bachelor's, you need to pay attention to entrance tests and language of instruction requirements.

sections.title: Degree in Computer Science Engineering and Recognition in Italy

items: Italian Universities award qualifications recognized in the Italian higher education system. A Bachelor's degree usually provides basic knowledge and may be required for further education. A Master's degree provides advanced technical and specialized training.
Students should be able to differentiate between the following qualifications:
Bachelor's in Computer Engineering: This includes fundamental concepts related to computing and engineering.
Master's in Computer Science and Engineering: Develop advanced skills in software systems, AI, computing infrastructure, and more.
Master's in Computer Science: Usually has a stronger focus on computing theory, algorithms, software and specialized computer science research.

Professional opportunities and curriculum vary by degree. Students who plan to return to India should see whether any qualification-recognition requirements apply to their intended employment or further education.

faq.question: How long does it take to do Master in Computer Science Engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: A standard Italian Master's degree usually takes two years and usually gives 120 ECTS credits.

faq.question: Does Computer Science Engineering have English programs in Italy?
faq.answer: A number of programs are taught in English, especially at Masters level. Many Bachelor engineering programs are however taught in Italian. Politecnico di Milano's Master's in Computer Science and Engineering is taught in English, while its Bachelor's in Engineering of Computing Systems is listed as Italian-taught.

faq.question: How much is it to study Computer Science Engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Tuition varies according to university, level of degree, and applicable fee. Students should review official fee schedules and inquire concerning scholarships or reductions in tuition for which they might be eligible.
